scope: Read-only Zotero Web API v3 and original Zotero software fixtures

sources.description: Unchanged upstream software fixture with 37 item types. Its example title/DOI/rights fields are test values, not a real scholarly bibliography.

nativeExample.description: Authored HTTP envelopes, collection memberships, child metadata, pagination/version/backoff events and reviewed revision changes over an unchanged retained upstream fixture. All served data is explicitly local protocol exercise data. No live Zotero read, account or remote write is asserted.
